review.method: Every frame inspected in four indexed contact sheets. Confirmed visible person, hard hat and vest for compliant/restricted frames; no helmet/vest for missing-PPE; no people for empty frames. Checked head/feet clipping and side of the fixed image-space restricted zone. Tight rendered semantic bounds independently verify person and PPE visibility. Raw frames have no zone overlay; the red contact-sheet line is review-only.
